prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Paint exactly ONE original Turnip Works fantasy tabletop UI pictogram: A vivid red heart bearing one jagged diagonal dark slash across its surface, with ONE large dark slate MINUS SIGN immediately to its right. Heart remains one whole recognizable shape, not split apart or dead. The minus is broad and bold, clearly reducing health. No bandage, no crossed-out status stripe. Heroic hand-painted style D: chunky miniature-safe forms, broad soft bevels, matte painted gradients, restrained brushwork, no glossy plastic. Centered on a warm pale parchment circular ground, quiet thin antique brass rim; ivory shapes instead dark slate for strong contrast. Straight-on circular badge, subject fills 80 percent of the disc, outer disc fills 94 percent of square canvas. Light from upper left. Palette: warm ochre wood, muted teal, ivory, slate, red only for danger or pin. Must read at 31 pixels: extremely simple silhouette, thick features, generous negative space, no tiny detail. Transparent outside the circle, preserve actual alpha. No text, lettering, numbers, watermark, decorative flourishes, extra symbols, or scene. Text-only original design; no third-party references.
processing: Native alpha preserved; transparent square padding when needed; Lanczos resize; lossless WebP.
blind_prompt:
This is one unlabelled button in the contextual menu around a selected piece
in a browser 3D virtual tabletop. View it at its supplied size.
What action does this button perform on the selected piece?
First describe the visible objects and marks, then give your single best action
interpretation and confidence (low/medium/high). If ambiguous, state why and one
plausible alternative. Do not assume any action from the filename. Be concise.
